other_conditions: Female applicants must be at least 55 years old
Male applicants must be at least 58 years old
Total annual income of the applicant's spouse must be less than ₹48,000 (exempted for BPL/Antyodaya/Aastha card holders and families belonging to Sahariya, Kathauri, Khairwa castes)
Applicant must be a native of Rajasthan and currently residing in Rajasthan
benefits_summary: Provides a pension of ₹1,000 per month to eligible seniors.
